## Description

Please describe the motivation and context for this change:
- What problem does this PR solve?
- Summary of key architectural or code changes.

Fixes # (issue)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring with no functional change
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating test cases
- [ ] `chore`: Build/tooling/dependency maintenance
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE`: Incompatible API or configuration change

---

## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and naming conventions of this project.
- [ ] I have executed `npm run typecheck` and confirmed no TypeScript errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `npm run test:e2e` and all end-to-end journey tests pass.
- [ ] I have verified with `gitleaks` that no secrets, tokens, or personal paths are committed.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (or `README*.md` aligned across all 10 supported languages if applicable).
